query: We want to extract checkout from our monolith. How should we approach ownership and deployment?
expected_behavior: Asks about or emphasises single-team end-to-end ownership before code
Warns against shared build/deploy coupling between teams
Routes to the appropriate reference (boundary-design or decisions-framework) rather than inventing a full Canvas
Does not generate a full Module Federation config until ownership is clear

query: Should catalog filters and product detail be separate micro-frontends on the same page?
expected_behavior: Discusses horizontal vs vertical split trade-offs
Flags risk of over-granular MFEs and coordination cost
Loads or cites boundary-design / decisions-framework as appropriate
Does not default to 'always more MFEs is better'

query: Marketing wants SSR for landing; checkout is client-only. Who owns edge routes?
expected_behavior: Addresses SSR / edge ownership as an architectural decision
Points at decisions-framework or related reference guidance
Keeps shell vs MFE route ownership distinct
Does not invent payment or product domain rules
